solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Adapt our city hall to a body that works there

indicators.note: to adapt is to alter or rework, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to make the town hall suitable for the council staff who work in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'there' points back to the city hall in the surface, so the definition only works once the fodder has been read as plain letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A local authority is the council, an organisation whose staff run a town from its civic offices.

clue.text: See what someone is saying?

parts.note: normally 'see' means understand, but here it is literal: following speech with the eyes by watching the mouth

explanation.walkthrough: 'See' usually means grasp or understand; the question mark hints it is to be taken literally, as watching lips move.
explanation.definitionFit: To lip-read is to follow speech by watching mouth movements, as deaf people often do.

clue.text: Pass learner in car — is one taking lessons? That could lead to crash

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
L is the learner plate displayed on a car
I is the Roman numeral for one
someone on a course is taking a series of lessons

explanation.surface: A driving instructor's question about overtaking a learner car, warning of a possible accident.
explanation.walkthrough: The ON COURSE piece is a phrase: someone taking lessons is 'on (a) course'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on a collision course means heading inevitably for an impact or clash.

clue.text: Bishop taken off chess player — one needs to have it

indicators.note: taken off says the letter for bishop is removed from the player's name, like a piece captured from the board

parts.note: in chess the two players are White and Black
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A chess player loses a bishop and badly needs one back.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess setting makes 'Bishop' look like a piece; it is just its abbreviation B.
explanation.definitionFit: If one needs something, one suffers a lack of it: a lack is the want or absence that makes the need.

clue.text: Improvement in parking secured by radical change in policy

indicators.note: secured by says the parking letter is held inside the policy reversal

parts.note: a U-turn is a complete reversal of policy
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A political story about better parking provision after a government reverses its policy.
explanation.definitionFit: An upturn is an upward trend, a recovery or rise in fortunes.

clue.text: Irritability in hard dispute that's growing, by the way

indicators.note: in says the irritability word sits inside the other pieces

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard
a row is a quarrel or dispute
edge means sharpness or irritability, as in 'an edge to his voice'

explanation.surface: Tempers fray in a tough argument that keeps escalating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by the way' is a pun: it means 'incidentally' but also 'beside the road', where a hedgerow grows.
explanation.definitionFit: A hedgerow is a living line of shrubs bordering a field or lane, growing beside the road.

clue.text: Harrison Ford includes a couple of top people for this party

definitions.text: Harrison Ford includes a couple of top people for this party

parts.words: Harrison Ford includes a couple of top people for this party
parts.note: the actor's name is really two US presidents, Benjamin Harrison and Gerald Ford, both from the same political party

explanation.walkthrough: The film star is a red herring: split the name into two surnames of US presidents and ask which party both led.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Harrison and Gerald Ford were both elected or served as Republican Party presidents of the United States.

clue.text: Leader of revolution tossing James off thrones

indicators.note: tossing means throwing about, so the letters of the following words are scrambled

explanation.surface: A revolutionary leader throwing King James from the throne.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the Glorious Revolution of 1688 that ousted James II, but the answer led the American Revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: Jefferson drafted the Declaration of Independence and was a leading figure of the American Revolution.

clue.text: Deny any changes, for example

indicators.note: changes means the letters of the word any are rearranged

parts.note: say is used to mean 'for example', as in 'a fruit, say an apple'

explanation.surface: An instruction to reject any alterations, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: To naysay is to refuse, contradict or oppose, saying no to something.

clue.text: Stick and whip needed for wild animal

parts.note: a pole is a long stick
the cat (cat-o'-nine-tails) is a whip

explanation.surface: An animal tamer's kit: a stick and a whip.
explanation.walkthrough: The cat here is the cat-o'-nine-tails, a historical whip.
explanation.definitionFit: The polecat is a wild mustelid, a relative of the weasel and ferret.

clue.text: Old map I converted into something of educational value

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone turns an antique map into a teaching aid.
explanation.definitionFit: A diploma is a certificate awarded for completing a course of study, so it has worth in education.

clue.text: As it happens, returned as bad

indicators.note: returned means the word is turned back to front

parts.note: a broadcast that is live goes out as it happens

explanation.surface: Something came back in a poor condition, as it turned out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As it happens' looks like a filler phrase meaning 'incidentally'; it is the broadcasting sense of LIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil means wicked or morally wrong, a strong sense of bad.

clue.text: Vegetables head served in small party

indicators.note: served in says the head word is put inside the party

parts.note: the Greens are a small political party
bean is slang for the head

explanation.surface: Vegetables, with the head of the table dishing up, at a little gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party' looks like a social do; it is the political Green Party. A 'bean' is old slang for the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Green beans are the edible pods of the bean plant, eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Mate coming from improved play after interval, perhaps

parts.note: better means improved
in a match the play after half-time is the second half

explanation.surface: A team-mate playing better after the break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mate' looks like a sports team-mate; it is a spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Better half is a jocular idiom for one's spouse or partner.

clue.text: Rubbish left on road in front of house

indicators.note: in a down or across clue, on means placed after, so the letter for left follows

parts.note: a drive is the private road up to a house

explanation.surface: Litter dumped on the street outside a house.
explanation.definitionFit: Drivel is foolish nonsense, rubbish in the sense of worthless talk.

clue.text: Dandy's invitation to flier to make a brief visit?

definitions.note: Dandy's here is 'dandy is', the noun the answer names

parts.note: to pop in is to call briefly
a jay is a bird, a flier

explanation.surface: A fop's invitation to a passing bird to drop by.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as 'Pop in, jay!', the invitation the clue describes.
explanation.definitionFit: A popinjay is a vain, showily dressed man, a fop or dandy.

clue.text: Get comfortably settled in children's concert

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the following words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Parents settling into their seats at a school concert.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensconce oneself is to settle snugly and securely into a place.

clue.text: Confine one to temporary accommodation in a sorry state

parts.note: to pen is to shut in or confine
I is the Roman numeral for one
a tent is a temporary shelter

explanation.surface: Someone forced to live in a tent, in a miserable condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sorry state' suggests wretchedness; here it means feeling sorry, i.e. remorseful.
explanation.definitionFit: Penitent means feeling regret and remorse for wrongdoing, being sorry.

clue.text: Quick to follow old man, top authority in church

indicators.note: to follow says the quick word comes after the father word

parts.note: pa, like 'old man', is a word for father
pacy means fast

explanation.surface: A quick succession to a dead elder as head of the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old man' is slang for a father, giving PA.
explanation.definitionFit: The papacy is the office of the Pope, the supreme authority of the Roman Catholic Church.

clue.text: Liberal inspiring fear long ago? Not causing offence

parts.note: awful once meant awe-inspiring or terrifying, an archaic sense

explanation.surface: A once-feared Liberal politician turns out to be harmless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' in its old sense meant full of awe, i.e. inspiring dread.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawful means permitted by law, so a lawful act is no criminal offence.

clue.text: Was paid under a pound, so became wiser

indicators.note: in a down answer, under means the payment word comes below the pound letter

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound (from libra)
earned means was paid for work

explanation.surface: Someone was paid less than a pound and wised up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under a pound' looks like a small sum; it is positional, the pieces stacked in the down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Learned here is the past tense of learn: gaining knowledge makes one wiser.

clue.text: Half-heartedly consume tea, say, in large cup

indicators.note: the heart of the eating word is its doubled middle letter, and only half of that pair is kept

parts.note: to gobble is to eat greedily
the letter T sounds like tea

explanation.surface: Drinking tea without enthusiasm from an oversized cup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half-heartedly' halves the heart: the middle BB of GOBBLE loses one B, giving GOBLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A goblet is a drinking vessel with a stem and foot, typically a large wine cup.

clue.text: It helps to work out all the angles for vehicle

definitions.text: It helps to work out all the angles

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
a tractor is a farm vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone helpful at seeing every angle of a situation, in favour of a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work out all the angles' sounds like scheming; it is literal geometry.
explanation.definitionFit: A protractor is a semicircular instrument used to measure angles in geometry.

clue.text: Dairy product of fine character from Greece

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek cheese of good quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character from Greece' sounds like a person; it is a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Feta is a white brined cheese made from sheep's or goat's milk, traditionally Greek.

clue.text: Priest taking part in ritual, a mass

indicators.note: taking part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A priest participating in a ceremonial mass.
explanation.definitionFit: A lama is a Tibetan Buddhist monk or spiritual teacher, a religious leader.

clue.text: Fixed middle parts of act entertainers put together

indicators.note: middle says to take the central letter of the word act

parts.note: the central letter of act

indicators.note: parts of says only a central section of the word entertainers is kept, its ends discarded

parts.note: with three letters dropped from each end, the central six letters remain
the first three and last three letters, the outer parts discarded

explanation.surface: A settled routine formed from the core of a performing troupe's show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle parts of' covers both words: C is the centre of ACT, and ERTAIN is the centre of ENTERTAINERS once three letters go from each end.
explanation.definitionFit: Certain can mean settled or definite, as in 'a certain sum', i.e. fixed.

clue.text: I am not well backed by boy in communication

parts.note: to ail is to be unwell, so 'I ail'
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A sick person supported by a boy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' looks like 'supported'; it signals that I AIL is read in reverse, giving LIAI.
explanation.definitionFit: A liaison is a link for exchanging information, contact and communication between groups.

clue.text: Crazy lass interfered, kept under control without help from others

definitions.text: kept under control without help from others

indicators.note: crazy means wild or mad, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A mad girl meddled and was held in check by others.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-restrained describes someone who controls their own impulses, holding back by their own will.
